tom-fobble-s-day.summary: A short novel in Garner's Stone Book Quartet about one day in the life of a boy and his grandfather, with sledding and work among the subjects. It is set in eastern Cheshire.
tom-fobble-s-day.title: Tom Fobble's Day

characters: Jeff — eight-year-old who finds the cube
The coach — new coach with a cube
too-much-magic.note: Lippincott, 1987, by Betsy Sterman; Open Library also lists a 1994 edition credited to Betsy and Samuel Sterman, which may be the edition in the notebook (written 'Betty & Samuel'). Draft 'Betty' corrected to Betsy.
too-much-magic.summary: Eight-year-old Jeff finds a cube that seems to grant wishes, and his older brother Bill discovers it actually teleports objects. Their wishes start affecting the whole town, and a new coach with a cube of his own asks them to hand theirs over.
too-much-magic.title: Too Much Magic

tortilla-flat.setting: Monterey, California, after World War I
tortilla-flat.summary: A band of easygoing friends in Monterey share a house, wine and a loose code of honor. Their kindly schemes keep going comically astray.
tortilla-flat.title: Tortilla Flat

characters: Dewey Martin — boy who pilots the raft
trouble-river.setting: A frontier river journey toward Hunter City
trouble-river.summary: Dewey Martin's parents are away, so the boy has to get his cranky grandmother and their lame dog Charlie to safety downriver on a homemade raft. They face wolves and rapids and find the cabin they were headed for burned and empty. They keep going toward Hunter City to find the Martins.
trouble-river.title: Trouble River

characters: The Man in the Yellow Suit
tuck-everlasting.note: Setting 1880 village Treegap, not generic New England; awards added.
tuck-everlasting.summary: Ten-year-old Winnie Foster discovers the Tuck family, who gained immortality from a spring in the woods. A stranger wants to exploit the water, and Winnie must choose what to do.
tuck-everlasting.title: Tuck Everlasting

uncle-tom-s-cabin.summary: A novel about enslaved people in America and the moral crisis of slavery.
uncle-tom-s-cabin.title: Uncle Tom's Cabin

unreal-eight-surprising-stories.note: Awards added; source fixed from author page to collection article.
unreal-eight-surprising-stories.series: Paul Jennings short story collections #1 (Unbelievable! 1986 follows)
unreal-eight-surprising-stories.summary: Eight funny, odd stories with twist endings, including Without a Shirt, Skeleton on the Dunny and Wunderpants. Several became episodes of the TV series Round the Twist.
unreal-eight-surprising-stories.title: Unreal! Eight Surprising Stories

characters: Dr. John Graham Bretton — handsome doctor
villette.summary: Lucy Snowe, a reserved young Englishwoman, makes her way as a teacher in the Belgian city of Villette. She finds love, loneliness and her own strong will.
villette.title: Villette

waiting-for-anya.summary: In occupied France in World War II, a boy named Jo helps hide Jewish children until they can escape over the mountains. A story of courage.
waiting-for-anya.title: Waiting for Anya

waterless-mountain.setting: Navajo country, American Southwest, early 20th century
waterless-mountain.summary: Younger Brother, a Navajo boy, grows up learning the ways of his people from his medicine-man uncle.
waterless-mountain.title: Waterless Mountain

watership-down.summary: A band of rabbits flees their doomed warren and searches for a new home on Watership Down. Along the way they face dangers, rival warrens, and friendship.
watership-down.title: Watership Down

when-hitler-stole-pink-rabbit.summary: A nine-year-old girl and her family flee Germany as the Nazis come to power.
when-hitler-stole-pink-rabbit.title: When Hitler Stole Pink Rabbit

where-the-red-fern-grows.summary: A boy in the Ozarks saves money to buy two coonhounds, and the three become a famed hunting team.
where-the-red-fern-grows.title: Where the Red Fern Grows

white-fang.summary: White Fang, a wolf-dog born in the wild, learns the harsh laws of survival and slowly comes to trust a kind master.
white-fang.title: White Fang

white-stallion-of-lipizza.note: Published by Rand McNally 1964; Borina is the stallion.
white-stallion-of-lipizza.summary: Hans, a baker's son in Vienna, dreams of working with the Lipizzan stallions of the Spanish Riding School. The book follows him and his horse Borina through training.
white-stallion-of-lipizza.title: White Stallion of Lipizza

who-put-that-hair-in-my-toothbrush.summary: Siblings Greg and Megan, who constantly feud, tell their own versions of the same events. It is a funny look at family rivalry.
who-put-that-hair-in-my-toothbrush.title: Who Put That Hair in My Toothbrush?

who-s-afraid-and-other-strange-stories.summary: A collection of short stories mixing quiet menace and the supernatural, set in ordinary English life.
who-s-afraid-and-other-strange-stories.title: Who's Afraid? and Other Strange Stories

wild-trek.note: Corrected: the characters are Link Stevens and Chiri, not Jim and Chinook. Holiday House, 1950.
wild-trek.summary: Trapper Link Stevens and his half-wild snow dog Chiri set out to rescue a naturalist stranded in the Caribou Mountains. They face a cougar, hostile wolves and the wilderness itself.
wild-trek.title: Wild Trek

winter-cottage.note: Macmillan, 1968, 178 pages (earlier draft said 1939). No WebSearch call completed.
winter-cottage.setting: A cottage in the Wisconsin woods during the Depression
winter-cottage.summary: A Depression-era family takes over a summer cottage in the Wisconsin woods for the winter. They welcome visitors, including a runaway youth and two strangers.
winter-cottage.title: Winter Cottage

witch-s-sister.summary: Eleven-year-old Lynn suspects her older sister Judith of witchcraft after strange events. She and her friend Mouse learn that Judith is under the influence of an old woman.
witch-s-sister.title: Witch's Sister

witch-week.summary: In a boarding school in a world where witchcraft is illegal, a note says someone in the class is a witch. Dramatic and funny.
witch-week.title: Witch Week

witches-children.summary: Told from a girl's eyes, a Salem girl is drawn into the witch trials hysteria.
witches-children.title: Witches' Children

wolf-hunt.note: Open Library lists a co-credit to William Bock (possibly the illustrator). Plot not verified. Year filled in from Open Library and Wikipedia.
wolf-hunt.summary: A juvenile novel about wolves and hunting by Walter D. Edmonds, published by Little, Brown in 1970.
wolf-hunt.title: Wolf Hunt

wolf-rider.note: Subtitle: A Tale of Terror. Draft character 'Mr. Zeeman' was not supported; the caller is Zeke. Setting not confirmed.
wolf-rider.summary: Fifteen-year-old Andy Zadinski gets a phone call from a stranger who claims to have killed a girl. Nobody believes him, and he has to push for the truth himself.
wolf-rider.title: Wolf Rider

wuthering-heights.summary: Heathcliff, a foundling raised at Wuthering Heights, is bound in a stormy love to Catherine Earnshaw and sets out to take revenge. A dark and passionate tale on the Yorkshire moors.
wuthering-heights.title: Wuthering Heights

yolonda-s-genius.summary: Yolonda's little brother Andrew is a harmonica genius. As a fifth-grader, she works hard to give him the chance he deserves.
yolonda-s-genius.title: Yolonda's Genius

you-were-princess-last-time.note: Previously unidentified. Open Library has You were princess last time by Laura Fisher (1965) with no description. Author identity and plot not verified.
you-were-princess-last-time.summary: A children's book by Laura Fisher, listed in Open Library as first published in 1965. No description was found, so the story is not summarized.
you-were-princess-last-time.title: You Were Princess Last Time

zlateh-the-goat-and-other-stories.summary: Seven stories from Jewish folk tradition, including the title story about a boy and his goat stranded in a blizzard. They are told with warmth, humor and magic.
zlateh-the-goat-and-other-stories.title: Zlateh the Goat and Other Stories
